notes.title: Demo Hotfix: Small Issues Resolved #2
notes.notes: [p][b]Hotfix Changelog:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved object placement from hand into target positions (e.g., computer)[/p][/*][*][p]Items taken off furniture are now marked as packed and ready for transport[/p][/*][*][p]Removed physics-based furniture lifting in Hard mode (caused flickering and physics glitches)[/p][/*][*][p]Holding the pickup key now collects multiple items automatically[/p][/*][*][p]Automatically selects the right box or bag when clicking on an item to pack[/p][/*][*][p]Text and localization improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Radial menu can now also be opened with the Tab key[/p][/*][*][p]Minor tutorial adjustments[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix: Small Issues Resolved
notes.notes: [p][b]Hotfix Changelog:[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Tailgate indicator fixed [/p][/*][*][p]Prevented items from falling under the wardrobe[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented items from falling under the floor[/p][/*][*][p]Completed missing shop item descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved control lock issue caused by player overlapping with furniture upon drop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where mission progress could stall in certain cases[/p][/*][*][p]Placed objects could still be marked as placement targets – fixed [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where a wardrobe not marked for moving could be picked up[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up that wardrobe could launch the player into space[/p][/*][/list]
